headlines.title: OpenAI and Anthropic bosses push UN for global terms on AI
headlines.summary: OpenAI's Sam Altman has called for risk evaluation standards, as have Anthropic's Dario Amodei and Hugging Face's Clement Delangue.

headlines.title: Surging prices, voters’ anger: How France’s fuel crisis could shape the presidential campaign
headlines.summary: In recent weeks, fishermen have blocked oil depots and port entrances in the south of France, while farmers have staged demonstrations over rising fuel prices. Fuel is set to become a major political flashpoint, just seven months away from France's elections.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Blair presses Burnham to back return to a reformed EU
headlines.summary: The former British prime minister says Brussels must be on a "credible path to reform" if the U.K. is to rejoin the bloc.

headlines.title: Trump reveals millions of dollars' worth of share deals in big tech and AI
headlines.summary: Stock in major firms such as Microsoft, Nvidia and SpaceX was bought and sold on behalf of the US president.

headlines.title: 'Largest global fuel supply disruption in history': Which Europeans are paying the most for fuel?
headlines.summary: The global oil crisis sent petrol and diesel peaking over €2.4/L and €2.5/L, but figures adjusted for the cost of living give a better indication of which countries are feeling the pinch the worst.

headlines.title: Will Germany have enough gas this winter amid energy supply crunch?
headlines.summary: Germany s gas storage sites are far less full than in recent years. Officials say supplies are secure, but analysts warn that a cold winter or import disruptions could push prices higher. So how secure is the supply?

headlines.title: Poland scrambles jets after Russian helicopter breaches its airspace
headlines.summary: Polish President Karol Nawrocki accused Russia of “ruthless persistence” in its efforts to “conquer a neighboring state."

headlines.title: AI superpower ambitions take centre stage as Trump and Xi meet
headlines.summary: The US and China are vying for AI supremacy while seeking to keep it under human control.

headlines.title: Turkey arrests Tera chairman as ‘Ponzi-like’ fund probe affects 450,000 investors
headlines.summary: Turkish authorities arrested the chairman of Tera Yatirim Menkul Degerler AS on Wednesday morning, the brokerage at the centre of the country's current investment fund scandal, with funds worth more than $18 billion (€15.7bn) and held by over 450,000 people now being liquidated.

headlines.title: Germany s car crisis: Can the 35-hour workweek survive?
headlines.summary: German carmakers want employees to work 40 hours instead of the current 35 without extra pay, arguing it would improve competitiveness. Unions strongly oppose the proposal and view it as an attack on workers rights.

headlines.title: ‘Dammit, something has to happen’: White House preparing plan for 90-day diesel exports ban
headlines.summary: Some GOP lawmakers and oil industry reps are still fighting to stave off an announcement.

headlines.title: Lidl banned from selling copycat Birkenstock sandals, Dutch court rules
headlines.summary: Lidl must also compensate Birkenstock and pay its legal fees, according to the court ruling

headlines.title: The Trump-Xi summit: Why Europe has so much at stake
headlines.summary: From tariffs to rare earths and AI, the agenda for US President Donald Trump's summit with China’s President Xi Jinping in Washington will have an impact on Europe.

headlines.title: Germany faces energy tax losses as EV sales rise
headlines.summary: The rapid shift to electric vehicles in Germany is cutting fuel tax revenue for the government. As EV sales surge, policymakers face growing pressure to find new ways to fund roads and transportation infrastructure.

headlines.title: A huit mois de la présidentielle, les comptes de campagne déjà sous surveillance
headlines.summary: POLITICO a rencontré Christian Charpy, le président de l’autorité administrative qui aura la responsabilité de valider ou non les dépenses des candidats à l’Elysée.

headlines.title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says
headlines.summary: Albanese said he expressed "concern" to OpenAI founder Sam Altman, after authorities were informed three months after the breach in June.

headlines.title: Spanish farmers demand urgent aid as war in Iran drives up costs
headlines.summary: Asaja, COAG, UPA, Unión de Uniones and the agri-food cooperatives are urging the government for direct aid over soaring farm diesel and fertiliser prices caused by the war in Iran, warning protests will go ahead if no action is taken.

headlines.title: EU’s Ribera joins push for first woman to lead UN
headlines.summary: Four women feature among the seven candidates seeking to replace António Guterres when he steps down at the end of the year.

headlines.title: Barrecore and Boom Cycle owner suddenly shuts studios
headlines.summary: Common Bond has emailed customers announcing its locations were closed "until further notice".

trend_headline: 글로벌 에너지 위기와 프랑스·독일의 구조적 진통
summary: 중동 분쟁 등 글로벌 에너지 위기로 연료 및 가스 가격이 급등하면서 프랑스의 연료 시위와 스페인 농가 지원 요구가 이어지는 가운데, 독일은 전기차 전환에 따른 세수 감소와 자동차 산업의 35시간 주 40시간 연장 갈등 등 심각한 제조업 위기에 직면했습니다. 이와 함께 ECB는 암호화폐 규제 강화를 촉구하며 금융 안정을 압박하고 있습니다.
key_points: 글로벌 에너지 위기로 휘발유 및 디젤 가격이 폭등하며 프랑스와 스페인 등에서 연료비 부담과 시위 확산
독일은 전기차 보급 가속화에 따른 연료세 수입 감소와 자동차 업계의 40시간 근무제 도입 요구로 노사 갈등 심화
ECB가 유럽연합에 더 강력한 암호화폐 규제와 스테이블코인 이자 지급 금지를 촉구하며 통화·금융 안정을 강조
